answer: Special Ops roll call: pay agents only through owners who show up at the same moment. Once a month a public beacon names the hour, like a comet sighting, with 60 minutes notice; every owner joins a five-minute video room with two random strangers and they vouch each other live. Servers can't crack that walnut: a person sits in only one room at a time, so 1,000 keys need 1,000 humans awake together, every month. An honest owner bends like a willow for five minutes; a farm misses the window and its keys earn nothing.
